en-US.description: User-friendly software utility that allows you to convert one or more text files to PDF. When you want to make sure unauthorized people cannot edit your text documents, you can convert them to PDF format.
en-US.longDescription:
Vovsoft Text to PDF Converter is a straightforward utility designed to turn plain text documents into PDF files. Built to simplify the conversion process, it includes a batch processing feature to handle multiple text files at once without extra hassle.

Whether saving notes, reports, or project documentation, this program provides a simple, user-friendly interface to help get the job done quickly.

When working with multiple documents, the output method can be chosen to best fit the task at hand:
* Single PDF: Combine all selected text files into one continuous PDF document.
* Multiple PDFs: Generate a separate PDF file for each individual text file selected.

To ensure PDFs look the way they are needed, the software includes several helpful formatting settings that are easy to adjust:
* Font: Change the text style to suit the document's purpose.
* Orientation: Select either Portrait or Landscape.
* Paper Size: Choose from standard dimensions, including A5, A4, A3, A2, A1, A0, Letter, and Legal.

Since manual formatting can be tedious, the batch processing and straightforward settings in this tool aim to save time. Whether for a student or a professional, Vovsoft Text to PDF Converter is here to quietly assist with everyday document tasks.
